important_recovery_history.m233_bounded_map: Filename-only fixture migration changed OpenVMS bounded directory ordering. Accepted recovery makes M233 self-contained with early-sorting synthetic fixtures while preserving the production 192-file ceiling.
important_recovery_history.rms_git_case_index: OpenVMS Git index operations may case-fold explicit SRC paths into separate lowercase src/carrier paths and may read older RMS versions. Exact VAX-tested publication must use GitHub aggregate tree verification and exact blob identity.
important_recovery_history.lowercase_src_audit: GitHub contains both SRC and lowercase src. OpenVMS collapses them into one physical [.SRC] directory. M267 survivor audits must inspect both Git path families; native VAX SEARCH over [.SRC] remains authoritative for the physical tree.
important_recovery_history.case_insensitive_search_false_positive: OpenVMS SEARCH/NOEXACT is case-insensitive. A requested uppercase macro token can match a lowercase function with the same letters; use SEARCH/EXACT when identifier case distinguishes the intended audit target.
important_recovery_history.github_actions_exact_publication: For large/multi-file GitHub publication, a temporary branch may run an exact asserted transformation, self-remove the workflow, then contribute only its verified tree to a clean one-parent commit on m267-llm-naming.
important_recovery_history.lesson: Never retire compatibility or namespace names from stale search alone; use exact branch-live GitHub audit plus physical VAX SEARCH/build acceptance.
